summary: A big named team and a free consultation for refugee clients are strengths, but copy errors and conflicting numbers appear to cost you trust and enquiries.

findings.problem: The page appears to say Immigration and Refuge Law, Law is complicate matter, and All Right Reserved, and the alt text spells Adam Wawrzkiewigz while the heading says Wawrzkiewicz.
findings.cost: Typos on a law firm homepage cost trust before the first call.

findings.problem: Menu parents such as Legal Services, Visitors, Students and Workers appear to link to #, and Family Class, Express Entry and Citizenship all appear to go to the same immigration law page.
findings.cost: Clients looking for a specific service find the same page every time.
findings.fix: Dedicated service pages that rank on Google.

findings.problem: The page says Canada's Largest Immigration and Refugee Law Firm and also this boutique law firm, Trusted By 10,000+ Clients beside more than 2000 clients, and team of 25 with 13 profiles shown.
findings.cost: Conflicting numbers weaken every other claim.

findings.problem: Booking is a link with no visible form, there is no WhatsApp, and trust badges appear to use blank placeholder images.
findings.cost: Clients in urgent cases leave when contact is hard.
findings.fix: Online booking with WhatsApp and real badges.

redesign: Dedicated service pages and booking form.
One set of verified numbers and proof.
